name: Reaching Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, arms extended overhead.
Sit up, reaching your hands past your knees toward the ceiling.
Keep the motion smooth — don't yank with your neck.
Lower with control, returning arms overhead. The reach adds range and workload.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Reaching Sit-Up is a beginner core exercise targeting the abs, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
